$comment: Hand-written expected requests for fixtures/specs/qa/request-shape-matrix.yaml (criterion 14), in the comparison form of ADR 0005 'How a received request is compared'. Written by hand from the spec and the ADR rules named in each 'rule', not from buildRequest or HttpRequest. Percent-escapes were worked out by hand from ADR 0005 'Text outside ASCII' rule 1 (UTF-8 bytes, every byte outside A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~ as % and two upper-case hex digits, space as %20) and cross-checked with Python's urllib.parse.quote(value, safe='-._~'). Fields: 'method' compared exactly; 'target' is path and query, compared byte for byte except the case of a percent-escape's hex digits; 'headers' each present exactly once, name without regard to ASCII case, value byte for byte after trimming spaces and tabs; 'contentType' compared as ADR 0005 says ('multipart/form-data' also needs a boundary); 'body' is {kind:'none'}, {kind:'json', value} compared parsed, {kind:'form', pairs:[[name,value]]} compared in order by the URL rule, or {kind:'multipart', parts:[{name, content, filename?, contentType?}]} compared in order; 'mustBeAbsent' lists header names that must not be present (ADR 0005: a declared parameter, a credential carrier, Cookie or Authorization not expected); 'status' is what the mock answers (ADR 0005 'It accepts a request': the selectResponseExample status when it is an exact 2xx code, else 200).
serverRule: ADR 0005 'The local mock': the port is fixed at 14010 and the matrix declares the mock as its first server; the harness refuses to run a sample whose base URL is not this one.

requests.rule: ADR 0005 rule 1: a path value is percent-encoded, space as %20; style simple
ADR 0005 rule 1: '&' is %26 and '+' is %2B in a value; style form, explode true gives one pair per array item; 'mode' has no example, so its first enum value (ADR 0005 'Rules', fill order)
ADR 0005: header values printable ASCII; an integer example is written as its decimal text (style simple)
ADR 0005 'How a received request is compared': JSON compared parsed; status 201 because the response example is under the exact 2xx code 201
ADR 0005 rule 1: form field values percent-encoded as in a query, space %20 never '+', '&' %26; pairs compared in order
ADR 0005: parts compared in order, name and content byte for byte; '"' is refused only in a part's name or filename (rule 2), not in its content

ADR 0003 security statement: http bearer is header Authorization with prefix 'Bearer '; ADR 0005 'What an M1 sample shows': display text YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN (that bearer uses the access_token variable is question QA-1)
ADR 0005 'Basic authentication': on the wire every sample sends the Base64 of YOUR_USERNAME:YOUR_PASSWORD; no sample text contains the encoded value
ADR 0003 security statement: apiKey in and name from the scheme, no prefix; display text YOUR_API_KEY
ADR 0003 security statement; the credential is a query pair

requests.shape: API key in a cookie, with a declared cookie
requests.rule: Beyond criterion 14's list. ADR 0005 'Cookies': one Cookie header, declared non-credential cookies first in parameter order, then the credential cookie; pairs joined by '; '

includes.rule: ADR 0004: the mock's address is http and localhost, so the proxy will not send to it (m1.md 'A mock-server build'). Pointer: the server object (question QA-7)

findings.exactCodesRule: Every value is declared (example or enum), so nothing is synthesized and no example-missing is due (ADR 0004 'example-missing' needs no example, default and enum); every header and cookie value is printable ASCII, so nothing is refused.
